title: Aamir Khan Married a Bengaluru Entrepreneur He Met 25 Years Ago. Their First Outing Was at a Kapoor Wedding.
excerpt: The Perfectionist's third marriage was a rainy Pali Hill affair with 150 guests, his children, and the blessings of both ex-wives. Then he and Gauri Spratt walked into Boney Kapoor's daughter's celebrations and Bollywood finally exhaled.
body:
There is a photograph making the rounds from **Anshula Kapoor's** wedding reception that tells you everything you need to know about where **Aamir Khan** is in his life right now. He is standing beside **Gauri Spratt** — salon entrepreneur, Bengaluru native, and, as of July 5, his wife — posing with **Boney Kapoor** and a roomful of people who have known him for thirty years. He looks relaxed. She looks radiant. They look like a couple who have nothing left to prove.

It was their first public outing as husband and wife, and Bollywood noticed.

## A Rainy Night in Pali Hill

The wedding itself was pure Aamir — private, deliberate, and completely on his terms. On the evening of July 5, as Mumbai's monsoon turned the streets into rivers, around 150 guests gathered at Khan's Pali Hill residence for an intimate registered ceremony. No leaked invites. No paparazzi stakeout. Just family, close friends, and the kind of quiet that a man on his third marriage earns the right to choose.

Filmmaker **Ashutosh Gowariker**, actress **Rhea Chakraborty**, and cricketer **Irfan Pathan** were among the guests who braved the downpour. All three of Khan's children — **Junaid**, **Ira**, and **Azad** — were there, along with Spratt's son **Quinn** from a previous marriage. By several accounts, the evening was warm, understated, and genuinely happy.

## A Love Story That Took 25 Years to Arrive

The backstory is the part that would make a good screenplay. Aamir and Gauri first crossed paths in Bengaluru more than two decades ago — a passing acquaintance that left no obvious trace on either of their lives. She went on to build a career in the beauty industry, running her own salon. He went on to become Bollywood's most meticulous leading man, marrying **Reena Dutta** and then **Kiran Rao**, both unions lasting exactly sixteen years.

They reconnected in 2023 through a mutual family connection. What started as renewed friendship deepened into something neither of them expected. On his 60th birthday in March 2025, Aamir did what Aamir does — he went public, introducing Gauri as his girlfriend with the kind of directness that leaves no room for speculation. She stood beside him at the premiere of *Sitaare Zameen Par*. The industry watched, and for once, mostly kept its commentary generous.

> "She changed my entire perspective on marriage," Khan told podcaster Raj Shamani earlier this year.

A month before the wedding, he confirmed the July 5 date publicly. No engagement ring circus. No destination-wedding spectacle. Just a date and a decision.

## Who Is Gauri Spratt?

For the diaspora audience that has followed Aamir's personal life with the same intensity as his films: **Gauri Spratt** is a Bengaluru-born entrepreneur who built her career in the beauty and wellness sector. She is not from the film industry. She is not a public figure by design. She now works at Aamir Khan Productions, but everything about her entry into Khan's world has been on her terms — gradual, grounded, and refreshingly unperformative.

She was previously married and has a son, Quinn, who was present at the wedding. In an industry that manufactures fairy tales for a living, her love story with Aamir reads more like a novel — a chance meeting, years of absence, and a second act that neither of them saw coming.

## The Family Equation

What makes this marriage remarkable in Bollywood terms is the family arithmetic. Both of Khan's former wives — Reena Dutta and Kiran Rao — have remained on warm terms with the actor. Their children were not just present at the wedding; they were part of it. Reports suggest the entire extended family may soon live under one roof in a ₹100 crore sky villa that Khan has purchased in Pali Hill.

Comedian **Shekhar Suman** captured the mood on his YouTube show *Shekhar Tonite* when he quipped that Khan was now running a "triple engine" — likening his marital journey to a political grand alliance. "Even PM Modi must be thinking he has a new competitor," Suman joked, before noting that the harmonious family gathering was a genuine example of *vasudhaiva kutumbakam* — the world is one family.

## What Comes Next

After the wedding, the newlyweds flew to Australia for a honeymoon — accompanied, in classic Aamir fashion, by his children. Khan is expected to attend the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne, where *Sitaare Zameen Par* has earned a nomination. Meanwhile, his slate remains the busiest it has been in years: a mythological superhero film with **Lokesh Kanagaraj**, the Silkyara tunnel rescue drama with **Kabir Khan**, and the partition cricket epic *Lalkaara* with **Ashutosh Gowariker** and **Rajkumar Hirani**.

But for now, the most compelling story in Aamir Khan's life is not one playing out on screen. It is the one that started in a Bengaluru salon, disappeared for two decades, and arrived at a Pali Hill living room on a monsoon night — with everyone who has ever mattered to him in the room.
